# Posting slots

3 routes. Base URL: `https://orbitwrite.com/api/v1`. Paths below are absolute.

| Method | Path | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| GET | `/api/v1/posting-slots/by-account` | Posting slots for every connected account |
| GET | `/api/v1/posting-slots` | List a workspace's posting slots |
| POST | `/api/v1/posting-slots` | Replace a workspace's posting slots |

### GET /api/v1/posting-slots/by-account

Posting slots for every connected account

Requires `postingSchedule:read`. One entry per live connected account with its weekly slots and the timezone they're anchored to. `GET /posting-slots` collapses the workspace to one distinct set of times; this keeps them separated, which is what a per-account posting queue needs to place a post.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |

**Responses**

- `200` — Each account's posting schedule
  - `AccountPostingScheduleList`
    - `accounts`: array of `AccountPostingSchedule`, required
      - `accountId`: string, required
      - `timezone`: string | null, required — IANA timezone the account's slot times are anchored to — the workspace's, falling back to the account's own for a workspace that never set one. Workspace-first on purpose: the calendar renders every account's slots against the single workspace zone, and a queue anchored to a diverging per-account zone places its instants off the slots the calendar shows — so it re-offers a slot that visibly holds a post. Slots recur at this wall-clock time, so the instant they fire shifts with DST. Null when neither is configured: the caller applies its own fallback, because only it knows the zone the times will be read in (the app uses the viewer's display timezone, matching the calendar).
      - `slots`: array of `PostingSlot`, required — The account's own slots, falling back to the workspace's distinct set when it has none of its own — an account connected after onboarding has no rows, and the calendar already places it on the workspace's times. Empty only when the workspace has no slots at all; callers apply their own default there rather than being handed an invented one.
        - `dayOfWeek`: integer (min 0, max 6), required — 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday
        - `minuteOfDay`: integer (min 0, max 1439), required — Minutes since local midnight
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`

### GET /api/v1/posting-slots

List a workspace's posting slots

Requires `postingSchedule:read`. Returns the distinct weekly (dayOfWeek, minuteOfDay) slots for the organization, plus its timezone. Used by the settings “Posting schedule” tab.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Query parameters**

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `organizationId` | string | no | Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace. |
| `accountId` | string | no | Scope to one connected account's schedule instead of the organization-wide default. When the account has no customized schedule yet, the organization's values are returned as a fallback. |

**Responses**

- `200` — The workspace's posting slots
  - `PostingSlotList`
    - `slots`: array of `PostingSlot`, required
      - `dayOfWeek`: integer (min 0, max 6), required — 0 = Monday … 6 = Sunday
      - `minuteOfDay`: integer (min 0, max 1439), required — Minutes since local midnight
    - `timezone`: string | null, required — IANA timezone the slots are anchored to, e.g. "Europe/London"
    - `frequencyPerWeek`: number | null, required — Posts-per-week goal the schedule was set to (from onboarding), used to restore the smart-mode stepper. Null when never configured.
    - `mode`: one of `"smart"` | `"manual"` | `null`, required — Whether the schedule was last saved in smart or manual mode. Null when never configured.
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`

### POST /api/v1/posting-slots

Replace a workspace's posting slots

Requires `postingSchedule:update`. Replaces the posting slots for every connected account in the organization — or for one account, with `accountId` — with the set derived from the chosen schedule (frequency + smart/manual). Idempotent: re-running replaces rather than accumulates.

**Auth:** API key or session

**Request body** (`application/json`)

- `ReplacePostingSlotsBody`
  - `organizationId`: string — Session callers only — an API key already determines the workspace.
  - `accountId`: string — Scope the update to one connected account instead of every account in the organization. The organization's own schedule columns are seeded from this write only while they're still unconfigured — once set, account-scoped writes never touch the org-wide fallback.
  - `mode`: one of `"smart"` | `"manual"` (default "smart")
  - `frequencyPerWeek`: number (max 100, default 1) — Smart mode: how many slots to spread across the week
  - `slots`: array of `ManualSlotInput` (max 50 items) — Manual mode: the checked day×time grid cells
    - `time`: string, required — Display time, e.g. "9:00 AM" or "14:30"
    - `days`: array of boolean (max 7 items), required — One boolean per day, Monday..Sunday
  - `timezone`: string (max length 100) — IANA timezone to anchor the schedule to, e.g. "America/Los_Angeles". Checked against the runtime's zone database — an unknown zone is a 400 rather than a schedule whose times nothing can resolve later.

**Responses**

- `200` — How many slots were created across how many accounts
  - `ReplacePostingSlotsResult`
    - `created`: integer, required
    - `accounts`: integer, required
    - `slotsPerAccount`: integer, required
- `400` — Invalid request
  - `Error`
- `401` — Not signed in
  - `Error`
- `403` — Not a member of the organization
  - `Error`
- `404` — The resource does not exist
  - `Error`
